messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Unclear integration and upload inclusions",
 "problem_statement": "Customers are uncertain whether their pricing plans include integrations with repair networks and unlimited document uploads. This confusion delays decisions and risks underutilizing or overpaying for features.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "Just confirming — does enterprise include unlimited integrations with garage systems?",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-26T09:40:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Yes, please — and while we’re at it, can you clarify how the pricing tiers handle integrations with third-party repair networks? Just to confirm, the annual license fee still includes unlimited document uploads and supplier integrations, right?",
   "route": "sales",
   "date": "2026-10-26T11:03:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The quotes are sales-route questions asking to confirm what pricing plans include (integrations with repair networks, unlimited uploads). This is confusion about pricing and plan inclusions, which is outside the product itself, and could be answered by sales or a help/pricing article. No product defect, feature request, or workaround is described.", "verdict": "fail"}
